paragraphs.text: translated by
1. TVASTAR prepares the bridal of his Daughter: all the world hears the tidings and assembles.
paragraphs.original: त्वष्टा दुहित्रे वहतुं कृणोतीतीदं विश्वं भुवनं समेति ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṣṭā duhitre vahatuṃ kṛṇotītīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sameti |

paragraphs.text: But Yama's Mother, Spouse of great Vivasvan, vanished as she was carried to her dwelling.
paragraphs.original: यमस्य माता पर्युह्यमाना महो जाया विवस्वतो ननाश
paragraphs.translit: yamasya mātā paryuhyamānā maho jāyā vivasvato nanāśa

paragraphs.text: 2. From mortal men they hid the Immortal Lady, made one like her and gave her to Vivasvan.
paragraphs.original: अपागूहन्नमृतां मर्त्येभ्यः कृत्वी सवर्णामददुर्विवस्वते ।
paragraphs.translit: apāgūhannamṛtāṃ martyebhyaḥ kṛtvī savarṇāmadadurvivasvate |

paragraphs.text: Saranyu brought to him the Asvin brothers, and then deserted both twinned pairs of children.
paragraphs.original: उताश्विनावभरद्यत्तदासीदजहादु द्वा मिथुना सरण्यूः
paragraphs.translit: utāśvināvabharadyattadāsīdajahādu dvā mithunā saraṇyūḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Guard of the world, whose cattle ne'er are injured, may Pusan bear thee hence, for he hath knowledge.
paragraphs.original: पूषा त्वेतश्च्यावयतु प्र विद्वाननष्टपशुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः ।
paragraphs.translit: pūṣā tvetaścyāvayatu pra vidvānanaṣṭapaśurbhuvanasya gopāḥ |

paragraphs.text: May he consign thee to these Fathers' keeping, and to the gracious Gods let Agni give thee.
paragraphs.original: स त्वैतेभ्यः परि ददत्पितृभ्योऽग्निर्देवेभ्यः सुविदत्रियेभ्यः
paragraphs.translit: sa tvaitebhyaḥ pari dadatpitṛbhyo'gnirdevebhyaḥ suvidatriyebhyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. May Ayu, giver of all life, protect thee, and bear thee forward on the distant pathway.
paragraphs.original: आयुर्विश्वायुः परि पासति त्वा पूषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात् ।
paragraphs.translit: āyurviśvāyuḥ pari pāsati tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt |

paragraphs.text: Thither let Savitar the God transport thee, where dwell the pious who have passed-before thee.
paragraphs.original: यत्रासते सुकृतो यत्र ते ययुस्तत्र त्वा देवः सविता दधातु
paragraphs.translit: yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayustatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu

paragraphs.text: 5. Pusan knows all these realms: may he conduct us by ways that are most free from fear and danger.
paragraphs.original: पूषेमा आशा अनु वेद सर्वाः सो अस्माँ अभयतमेन नेषत् ।
paragraphs.translit: pūṣemā āśā anu veda sarvāḥ so asmām̐ abhayatamena neṣat |

paragraphs.text: Giver of blessings, glowing, all-heroic, may he, the wise and watchful, go before us.
paragraphs.original: स्वस्तिदा आघृणिः सर्ववीरोऽप्रयुच्छन्पुर एतु प्रजानन्
paragraphs.translit: svastidā āghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro'prayucchanpura etu prajānan

paragraphs.text: 6. Pusan was born to move on distant pathways, on the road far from earth and far from heaven.
paragraphs.original: प्रपथे पथामजनिष्ट पूषा प्रपथे दिवः प्रपथे पृथिव्याः ।
paragraphs.translit: prapathe pathāmajaniṣṭa pūṣā prapathe divaḥ prapathe pṛthivyāḥ |

paragraphs.text: To both most wonted places of assembly he travels and returns with perfect knowledge.
paragraphs.original: उभे अभि प्रियतमे सधस्थे आ च परा च चरति प्रजानन्
paragraphs.translit: ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe ā ca parā ca carati prajānan

paragraphs.text: 7. The pious call Sarasvati, they worship Sarasvati while sacrifice proceedeth.
paragraphs.original: सरस्वतीं देवयन्तो हवन्ते सरस्वतीमध्वरे तायमाने ।
paragraphs.translit: sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante sarasvatīmadhvare tāyamāne |

paragraphs.text: The pious called Sarasvati aforetime. Sarasvati send bliss to him who giveth.
paragraphs.original: सरस्वतीं सुकृतो अह्वयन्त सरस्वती दाशुषे वार्यं दात्
paragraphs.translit: sarasvatīṃ sukṛto ahvayanta sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryaṃ dāt

paragraphs.text: 8. Sarasvati, who camest with the Fathers, with them rejoicing thee in our oblations,
paragraphs.original: सरस्वति या सरथं ययाथ स्वधाभिर्देवि पितृभिर्मदन्ती ।
paragraphs.translit: sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayātha svadhābhirdevi pitṛbhirmadantī |

paragraphs.text: Seated upon this sacred grass be joyful, and give us strengthening food that brings no sickness.
paragraphs.original: आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयस्वानमीवा इष आ धेह्यस्मे
paragraphs.translit: āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayasvānamīvā iṣa ā dhehyasme

paragraphs.text: 9. Thou, called on as Sarasvati by Fathers who come right forward to our solemn service,
paragraphs.original: सरस्वतीं यां पितरो हवन्ते दक्षिणा यज्ञमभिनक्षमाणाः ।
paragraphs.translit: sarasvatīṃ yāṃ pitaro havante dakṣiṇā yajñamabhinakṣamāṇāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Give food and wealth to present sacrificers, a portion, worth a thousand, of refreshment.
paragraphs.original: सहस्रार्घमिळो अत्र भागं रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धेहि
paragraphs.translit: sahasrārghamiḷo atra bhāgaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhehi

paragraphs.text: 10. The Mother Floods shall make us bright and shining, cleansers of holy oil, with oil shall cleanse us:
paragraphs.original: आपो अस्मान्मातरः शुन्धयन्तु घृतेन नो घृतप्वः पुनन्तु ।
paragraphs.translit: āpo asmānmātaraḥ śundhayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapvaḥ punantu |

paragraphs.text: For, Goddesses, they bear off all defilement: I, rise up from them purified and brightened.
paragraphs.original: विश्वं हि रिप्रं प्रवहन्ति देवीरुदिदाभ्यः शुचिरा पूत एमि
paragraphs.translit: viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīrudidābhyaḥ śucirā pūta emi

paragraphs.text: 11. Through days of earliest date the Drop descended on this place and on that which was before it.
paragraphs.original: द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द प्रथमाँ अनु द्यूनिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः ।
paragraphs.translit: drapsaścaskanda prathamām̐ anu dyūnimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ |

paragraphs.text: I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop which still to one same place is moving.
paragraphs.original: समानं योनिमनु संचरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः
paragraphs.translit: samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ

paragraphs.text: 12. The Drop that falls, thy stalk which arms have shaken, which from the bosom of the press hath fallen,
paragraphs.original: यस्ते द्रप्स स्कन्दति यस्ते अंशुर्बाहुच्युतो धिषणाया उपस्थात् ।
paragraphs.translit: yaste drapsa skandati yaste aṃśurbāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt |

paragraphs.text: Or from the Adhvaryu's purifying filter, I offer thee with heart and cry of Vasat!
paragraphs.original: अध्वर्योर्वा परि वा यः पवित्रात्तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम्
paragraphs.translit: adhvaryorvā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāttaṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam

paragraphs.text: 13. That fallen Drop of thine, the stalk which from the ladle fell away,
paragraphs.original: यस्ते द्रप्स स्कन्नो यस्ते अंशुरवश्च यः परः स्रुचा ।
paragraphs.translit: yaste drapsa skanno yaste aṃśuravaśca yaḥ paraḥ srucā |

paragraphs.text: This present God Brhaspati shall pour it forth to make us rich.
paragraphs.original: अयं देवो बृहस्पतिः सं तं सिञ्चतु राधसे
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu rādhase

paragraphs.text: 14. The plants of earth are rich in milk, and rich in milk is this my speech;
paragraphs.original: पयस्वतीरोषधयः पयस्वन्मामकं वचः ।
paragraphs.translit: payasvatīroṣadhayaḥ payasvanmāmakaṃ vacaḥ |

paragraphs.text: And rich in milk the essence of the Waters: make me pure therewith.
paragraphs.original: अपां पयस्वदित्पयस्तेन मा सह शुन्धत
paragraphs.translit: apāṃ payasvaditpayastena mā saha śundhata
